description: This Java source file defines the class 'Thing3ValuePredicateVisitor', which implements a visitor for evaluating criteria against 'Thing' objects, considering unknown fields. It includes methods for logical operations on criteria and manages evaluation logic with respect to partial or incomplete 'Thing' instances.

classes.name: Thing3ValuePredicateVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class implementing criteria evaluation logic against 'Thing' objects with respect to unknown fields, supporting logical combinations and evaluation strategies.

classes.name: Thing3ValuePredicateVisitor.Trilean
classes.description: An enum representing three logical states: TRUE, FALSE, and UNKNOWN, with methods for logical operations and value lifting.

classes.name: Thing3ValuePredicateVisitor.GetJsonPointer
classes.description: A private static class implementing FieldExpressionVisitor to extract JsonPointer paths from field expressions.

methods.name: couldBeTrue
methods.description: Static method to evaluate if a criteria could be true given a set of unknown fields and a partial thing.

methods.name: visitAnd
methods.description: Handles the logical AND of multiple criteria functions.

methods.name: visitAny
methods.description: Represents the OR over an empty set, always evaluates to true.

methods.name: visitExists
methods.description: Evaluates whether a field exists, considering unknown fields.

methods.name: visitField
methods.description: Evaluates a field expression with a predicate, considering unknown fields.

methods.name: visitNor
methods.description: Logical NOR operation on a list of criteria functions.

methods.name: visitOr
methods.description: Logical OR operation on a list of criteria functions.

methods.name: isUnknownField
methods.description: Checks if a given field expression path is in the set of unknown fields.
